detailed_descriptions.en: Minsgon Simulator is a first-person shop and creature-management sim where you hatch magical creatures from eggs, tame and train them, and raise them in your own shop. Discover over 150 Minsgon species, love and tame them all, and fill your collection with legends. Incubate the Mysterious Eggs Carefully place your eggs in the incubators. Over time, each one hatches into a Minsgon with its own traits. Rare eggs may yield the most precious creatures of all, the treasures of your collection. Each Egg Hatches a Minsgon All Its Own Every Minsgon that hatches is unique: its species, rarity, and temperament all differ. Some are cute, some are powerful, some are legendary; only time will tell which one appears. Record every species you discover in your catalogue (Dex) and complete your collection. Tame the Wild Minsgons With Love Gentle them little by little by petting, feeding, and cleaning them. The rarer they are, the more coy they become; winning a legendary Minsgon's heart takes patience and care. Your kindness is never wasted: well cared for Minsgons grow happier and sell for far higher prices. Train and Evolve Into Majestic Forms Place your tamed Minsgons on training stands; over time they gather experience. Those that grow strong enough evolve into grander, more enchanting forms. Evolution raises both their power and their value; rare evolved forms are priceless to collectors. Build a Magical Exhibit in Your Garden Sell entry tickets to visitors and earn a bountiful income from your exhibit area. Showcase and Sell Your Minsgons Display the Minsgons you hatch or raise in your garden and your collection. At the sales stand, set your own price on each Minsgon; let the customer who likes it come and buy it. Some Minsgons are so special you cannot bear to sell them, so you keep them for yourself. Open Your Own Shop and Welcome Your Customers Open your own shop and fill your shelves with colorful products. Customers shop according to their hearts and their purses; some stretch their budget, others just browse the window. Step up to the counter, take the payment, and give the correct change; a satisfied customer will knock on your door again. Hire Helpers and Grow Your Business Hire stockers, cashiers, hatchery workers, and caretakers to carry the load of your shop and garden. Set the rules for how each of them works. Watch your helpers handle the daily bustle while you plan the bigger picture. Grow Your Magical Powers As you gain experience, advance through the skill tree and unlock new powers. Float objects through the air, pull them to you from afar with telekinesis, and carry far more at once. Develop your abilities to craft your own magical working style and speed up your work. A Living World Full of Surprises A traveling merchant's special wagon stops by now and then, offering rare eggs and opportunities. Customer demands shift; the savvy trader who follows the market comes out ahead. With Twitch integration, make your viewers a part of the game. Expand Your Shop and Become a Legend Start from a small shop and grow step by step. Add new areas, more shelves, and stronger incubators. Make your shop the biggest and most respected in the city.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Minsgon Simulator is a first-person shop and creature-management sim where you hatch magical creatures from eggs, tame and train them, and raise them in your own shop. Discover over 150 Minsgon species, love and tame them all, and fill your collection with legends.

Incubate the Mysterious Eggs

  • Carefully place your eggs in the incubators.

  • Over time, each one hatches into a Minsgon with its own traits.

  • Rare eggs may yield the most precious creatures of all, the treasures of your collection.

Each Egg Hatches a Minsgon All Its Own

  • Every Minsgon that hatches is unique: its species, rarity, and temperament all differ.

  • Some are cute, some are powerful, some are legendary; only time will tell which one appears.

  • Record every species you discover in your catalogue (Dex) and complete your collection.

Tame the Wild Minsgons With Love

  • Gentle them little by little by petting, feeding, and cleaning them.

  • The rarer they are, the more coy they become; winning a legendary Minsgon's heart takes patience and care.

  • Your kindness is never wasted: well cared for Minsgons grow happier and sell for far higher prices.

Train and Evolve Into Majestic Forms

  • Place your tamed Minsgons on training stands; over time they gather experience.

  • Those that grow strong enough evolve into grander, more enchanting forms.

  • Evolution raises both their power and their value; rare evolved forms are priceless to collectors.

Build a Magical Exhibit in Your Garden

  • Sell entry tickets to visitors and earn a bountiful income from your exhibit area.

Showcase and Sell Your Minsgons

  • Display the Minsgons you hatch or raise in your garden and your collection.

  • At the sales stand, set your own price on each Minsgon; let the customer who likes it come and buy it.

  • Some Minsgons are so special you cannot bear to sell them, so you keep them for yourself.

Open Your Own Shop and Welcome Your Customers

  • Open your own shop and fill your shelves with colorful products.

  • Customers shop according to their hearts and their purses; some stretch their budget, others just browse the window.

  • Step up to the counter, take the payment, and give the correct change; a satisfied customer will knock on your door again.

Hire Helpers and Grow Your Business

  • Hire stockers, cashiers, hatchery workers, and caretakers to carry the load of your shop and garden.

  • Set the rules for how each of them works.

  • Watch your helpers handle the daily bustle while you plan the bigger picture.

Grow Your Magical Powers

  • As you gain experience, advance through the skill tree and unlock new powers.

  • Float objects through the air, pull them to you from afar with telekinesis, and carry far more at once.

  • Develop your abilities to craft your own magical working style and speed up your work.

A Living World Full of Surprises

  • A traveling merchant's special wagon stops by now and then, offering rare eggs and opportunities.

  • Customer demands shift; the savvy trader who follows the market comes out ahead.

  • With Twitch integration, make your viewers a part of the game.

Expand Your Shop and Become a Legend

  • Start from a small shop and grow step by step.

  • Add new areas, more shelves, and stronger incubators.

  • Make your shop the biggest and most respected in the city.
